verdict.rationale: A state business-filing authority could plausibly publish an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a bulk-data dictionary, so this axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows any machine-readable specification. The Gateway and tax pages cover only portal sign-in, user tips, and tax services. The probes show ohiosos.gov and bsportal.ohiosos.gov returning 403 at robots.txt, so no developer documentation could be found or verified there.
